Job Description

Business Title:
Indicators Economic Data Analyst

Exemption: Exempt

Work Schedule

Work Schedule: Hybrid work arrangement with at least 2 days per week on-site.

Budgeted Salary

$91,644-$123,000

School/Unit Description

The Stanford Digital Economy Lab conducts groundbreaking research on the impact of the digital economy. We bring together an interdisciplinary group of researchers to study how digital technologies are transforming work, organizations, and the economy. Our insights help companies, policymakers, students, and professionals respond to the opportunities and challenges created by digitization. The Lab is part of the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence and is co-sponsored by the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research.

Position Summary

The Stanford Digital Economy Lab is seeking an Economic Data Analyst to perform complex technical and analytical work supporting Indicators , the Lab’s public-facing platform for measuring the economic impact of artificial intelligence. Reporting to the Research Manager for Indicators, this position will query and integrate structured economic and labor-market data, independently produce standard and custom reports, devise methods for identifying patterns and trends, build non-routine analytical databases, and create publication-ready metrics and visualizations with minimal supervision.

The Economic Data Analyst will clean, validate, integrate, and document data from sources including ADP, the U.S. Census Bureau, job-posting providers, government agencies, surveys, and public repositories. The analyst will create analysis-ready relational tables, longitudinal datasets, derived indicators, data dictionaries, quality-control summaries, reports, charts, dashboards, and approved data extracts. The position will also develop and evaluate algorithms and statistical models related to AI adoption and exposure, employment, wages, occupations, industries, and skills demand; recommend improvements to data collection and reporting; respond to non-routine analytical and survey requests; implement data standards and common metric definitions; and test prototype pipelines, APIs, calculations, database changes, and visualizations for release readiness.

The successful candidate will work closely with economists, faculty, research scientists, postdoctoral scholars, graduate research assistants, data providers, engineers, designers, communications teams, and other Stanford partners. The role requires strong technical judgment, careful documentation, and the ability to translate complex findings into trustworthy information for academic, policy, industry, media, and public audiences.

This fixed-term position (3 years, renewable)

Preferred/Desired Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and three years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant experience, in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, computer science, data science, or engineering.

Strong SQL and Python skills; experience with R, cloud environments such as Google Cloud, Git-based version control, APIs, and visualization or business-intelligence tools is preferred.
Experience working with large economic or labor-market datasets, including restricted, licensed, or confidential data.
Knowledge of econometrics, data analysis, data visualization, reproducible research, and artificial intelligence measurement.
Excellent analytical, organizational, written, and oral communication skills; ability to complete detailed work accurately under deadlines with minimal supervision.
Creative, independent problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate with researchers and technical partners from diverse backgrounds.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Evaluate and develop new or modifications of usable data from complex data sources. Assess and produce relevant, standard, or custom information (reports, charts, graphs, and tables) from structured data sources by querying data repositories and generating the associated information.
Devise methods for identifying patterns and trends in available information sources using a variety of qualitative and quantitative techniques. Determine and recommend additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based on data in the database. Distribute and disseminate reports to applicable agencies, researchers, management, and other internal end-users.
Create non-routine databases and generate related information summaries.
Perform statistical analyses appropriate to complex data and reporting requirements.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Lead the implementation of data standards and common data elements for data collection.
Collaborate with technical staff to standardize and systemize routine reports, dashboards, and metrics.
May test prototype software and participate in the approval and release process for new software.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree.

Minimum Experience

Three years of relevant experience or combination of education and relevant experience. Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, or engineering.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

In-depth knowledge and experience using and applying analytical software, database management system software, database reporting software, database user interface and query software, and data mining software.
Demonstrated ability to collect data using a variety of methods, such as data mining and hardcopy or electronic documentation study, to improve or expand databases.

Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills.

The Project Coordinator (PC) is an integral member of the project team responsible for directing, organizing and controlling project activities. The Project Coordinator supports the logistics, planning and coordination throughout the project lifecycle. Project Coordinators will work with the Sales and Technical Operations teams and will assist with project kick-offs, equipment ordering/tracking, through project closeout procedures. This includes, but not limited to, creating project documents, coordinating vendors, tracking procurement, scheduling and attending project meetings, as well as other project related tasks. The Project Coordinator works closely with the Project Management and Technical Operations Teams to ensure project success. The Project Coordinator will also work closely with the coordination of various team members and stakeholders.

Location:
Virtual U.S. position; preferred work location/time zone is Mountain (MST/MT)
or Central (CST/CT)
.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Review customer purchase orders and contracts for compliance with Diversified's policies and requirements. Coordinates with sales and PM to resolve issues.
Provides efficient, accurate and effective administrative and clerical support to the Tech Ops department
Provide general administrative support for Project Teams and local management
Coordinates with designated AR staff to initiate regular project billings per contract requirements and established billing rules. Including AIA billing documents if applicable.
Provides the most project support during the Initiating, purchasing and Closing Project Phases but is involved in the entire project lifecycle.
Assist in posting all critical project documentation on enterprise document management portals
Assist Project Managers in creating and initiating project change orders within our ERP.
Is the primary interface between the PM and the Procurement Group
Assist in the management of the Bill of Materials (BoM) for active projects
Working with Shipping & Receiving to help coordinate project deliveries

Attends training classes as required by the needs of the department and assigned by management

Provide clerical support for project managers regarding equipment tracking, documentation logging and obtaining subcontractor/vendor quotes
Check on equipment delivery status for active projects and follow up with order entry on any missing POs, etc.
Provides efficient, accurate and effective administrative and clerical support

WEEKLY

Attend project meetings and assist PM’s with meeting agendas and tasks

MONTHLY

Organize monthly labor reports for active projects in the region
Reproduces needed forms for project preparation and service

Education & Certifications

High School diploma or GED
Two year technical/business degree or equivalent work experience preferred
AVIXA CTS Certification is desirable

2+ years of experience in an administrative support role and/or projects-related role
Experience with MS Office suite of software products with an emphasis on MS Word skills
Familiarity with project management software, such as MS Project, is a plus
Experience at working both independently and in a team-oriented environment is essential
Technically competent with various software programs, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.
Effectively and accurately communicate relevant project information to the project team
Can conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Reacts to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently
Skills to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources and all departments within the company
Strong written and oral communication skill
Strong organizational skills
Adept at conducting research into project-related issues and products
Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment is crucial
Well organized with the ability to multi-task
Ability to work under the pressure of many simultaneous project needs

Decision Making Authority

The PC is responsible for providing project and clerical support for project managers and the Tech Ops team. He/she should work transparently with their management to manage their bandwidth and tasks, as well as understanding Diversified’s processes and procedures. The PC will always get direction from the PM’s and management on any difficult or unusual situations.

Work will be performed in normal office environment. On-site presence will be as needed by the project, usually this is infrequent. While performing the duties of the job, frequently required to sit and talk or listen to others over the telephone and/or in person. The individual is regularly required to use their hands to finger keyboard and feel and reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required for this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work-life balance:

Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs
HSA & HRA company contributions

Dental coverage, including orthodontic benefits, and vision plans

Company-paid Benefits

Basic Life, AD&D
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Generous paid time off — 3 weeks PTO plus company holidays and floating holidays
401k with company match
Paid maternity leave
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

Provide general administrative support for Project Teams and local management
